item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.15)] Apple Takes Aim at AI Agents, Wants Mac Users to Know When Their Data Is Accessed as Meta Tackles Muse Privacy Claims
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Neutral (+0.15)
Apple plans to update macOS to notify users when AI agents, like Meta's Muse, try to access system data, addressing privacy concerns. This move comes after criticism that AI agents, which can bypass standard protections with "Full Disk Access," might expose sensitive personal information. Apple emphasized its commitment to user privacy and will implement new security controls requiring explicit user action for such data access.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.27)] AAPL To Flag AI Requests For Data Access On Macs Amid Complaints Over META's Muse Agent
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bullish (+0.27)
Apple Inc. (AAPL) is enhancing privacy controls on Mac computers by requiring more explicit user action for applications to gain broad access to data via its Full Disk Access feature, citing risks from increasingly autonomous AI agents. This move follows criticisms regarding Meta Platforms Inc.'s (META) Muse AI agent and its alleged access to private Messages content, though Meta disputes these claims. Apple emphasizes the need for users to make informed decisions about data access in the era of advanced AI.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.24)] South Korea and U.S. Ink Massive Nuclear Energy Plan
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.24)
South Korea and the U.S. have announced a major agreement to build eight large-scale nuclear reactors (two APR1400s and six AP1000s) in the U.S. by 2030, with a planned investment of $120 billion. However, an analysis raises concerns about the feasibility of the aggressive timeline, lack of commitments from U.S. utilities, and challenges in securing congressional funding due to rapidly escalating national debt. The article also covers other nuclear energy developments, including a Constellation-Amazon power purchase agreement, Holtec's SMR-300 PSAR submission, General Matter's license application for a Paducah enrichment plant, Deployable Energy's selection to test its nuclear battery at NRIC's DOME, NANO Nuclear Energy's acquisition of NRC-licensed fuel processing assets, and a proposed U.S. Fusion Energy Act with a $10 billion investment.

item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.23), AMZN Neutral (+0.15)] Report: Amazon to offload $8B worth of AI chips, lease them back
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.23), AMZN Neutral (+0.15)
Amazon.com Inc. is reportedly planning a financial maneuver to offload approximately $8 billion worth of AI chips, specifically Grace Blackwell accelerators, into a special purpose vehicle (SPV) and then lease them back. This strategy, similar to those employed by other tech giants, aims to remove the assets and associated debt from Amazon's balance sheet, thereby improving its debt-to-equity ratio and credit rating. The SPV will issue debt and a 10% equity stake to external investors to finance the deal, which involves between 114,000 and 133,000 chips installed in five Amazon data centers.

item.title: [AAPL Bullish (+0.29), AMZN Neutral (+0.04)] Apple's New Gadgets May Be Home Security Cameras. The Twist? They Won't Actually Record Video
item.description:

Instead, these cameras, codenamed J450, will use AI and very low frame rates to analyze home environments as visual sensors for Apple's smart home system, such as the rumored HomePad controller. This approach aligns with Apple's strong user privacy philosophy, similar to how future AirPods might use cameras as sensors without capturing high-resolution footage.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.11)] Higher yields: a benign mix for equities, for now
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.11)
US 10-year yields have significantly risen, typically favoring cheaper stocks, yet growth stocks have outperformed due to the specific composition of the yield move. The majority of this increase reflects higher expected real short-term interest rates, largely driven by the repricing of the US Federal Reserve's policy amid resilient growth and sticky inflation, which has been benign for companies with strong earnings. However, risks remain from potential shifts in the yield composition towards the term premium or energy-driven inflation, or a slowdown in growth that could undermine earnings.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.05), AMZN Bullish (+0.25)] Amazon seeks to offload US$8 billion of Nvidia chips to investors
item.description:
